_about: The Suggest page (flattery.sala.company/suggest/) sends each suggestion as a message to this ntfy.sh channel: free, no sign-up. Each scan reads the channel (ntfy.sh keeps messages 12 hours, and scans run every 8). Follow the channel in the ntfy app to see suggestions arrive. Empty: the page offers only #FlatteryAdd on X. alerts_topic: the public channel the scan posts newly loved apps and the weekly newsletter to; visitors follow it in the free ntfy app or ntfy.sh in a browser (🔔 Follow on the site).
